name: How much does per-page JSON-LD website schema generation cost for a small business?

mainEntity.name: How much does per-page JSON-LD website schema generation cost for a small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per-page JSON-LD generation typically costs $5–$25 per page for manual services, $50–$200/month for automated tools, or $500–$2,000+ for full-site custom implementation. Small sites (10–30 pages) often pay $150–$600 total, while enterprise sites with 500+ pages use automation to keep costs under $300/month.
